versions.description_html:
Learn serverless computing in plain language. Understand Azure Functions, event-driven architecture, Power Automate integration, costs, and common pitfalls.

The word serverless is a lie, and the truth behind it is far more useful. There's no such thing as computing without servers, but there's a way to stop renting machines you barely use.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why the word serverless trips almost everyone up
  • What serverless computing actually means
  • How serverless decides when to run and what it costs
  • Where serverless already lives in Microsoft 365
  • The jobs serverless is genuinely good at
  • The limits that surprise people
  • The mistakes beginners make with serverless
  • How to start with serverless without overthinking it

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
